requirements.statement: Staff request equipment loans by choosing an item and the loan dates.
requirements.source_quote: Staff request equipment loans by choosing an item and the loan dates.
ambiguity_notes: How items are chosen (catalogue, search, category) is not stated.
Whether the item's availability on the chosen dates is checked is not stated.
Limits on loan length or how far ahead dates can be set are not stated.
Whether staff can edit or cancel a request after submitting is not stated.

requirements.statement: Line managers approve or decline loan requests.
requirements.source_quote: Line managers approve or decline loan requests.
ambiguity_notes: Which line manager acts on a request (the requester's own, any, a delegate) is not stated.
Whether a reason is required or given when declining is not stated.
What happens if a request is not actioned is not stated.
Whether the requester is notified of the decision is not stated.

requirements.statement: Staff can see the status of their loan requests.
requirements.source_quote: Staff can see the status of their loan requests.
ambiguity_notes: The set of statuses is not stated (only approved and declined are implied).
Whether staff see only their own requests is implied by 'their' but not explicit.
Whether the decline reason or history is visible is not stated.

clarifying_questions.question: Which line manager can approve or decline a given request: the requester's own manager only, any line manager, or a delegate when the manager is away?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Determines roles, permissions and routing of requests.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Approval permissions cannot be specified; the wrong people may approve loans.

clarifying_questions.question: Should the system check that the chosen item is available on the requested dates, and what happens if it is not?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Affects request validation, data needed on existing loans and error behaviour.

clarifying_questions.question: Can staff edit or cancel a request after submitting it, and are there limits on loan length or advance booking?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Changes the request lifecycle and validation rules.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Lifecycle and date rules cannot be specified.

clarifying_questions.question: Must a manager give a reason when declining, and should staff be notified of the decision (and how)? What happens if a request is never actioned?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Affects data captured, notifications and timeouts.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Decline and notification behaviour stays undefined.

clarifying_questions.question: Which statuses should a loan request have (for example pending, approved, declined, cancelled, returned), and what should staff see beyond the status?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Defines the status model shown to staff.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: The status list and displayed detail cannot be specified.

proposed_status_changes.reason: Which line manager may approve or decline is not stated (CQ-001).
